heating_element.name: Coiled Electric Heating Element
heating_element.description: High-resistance nichrome/copper immersion element that converts electrical energy into thermal energy via Joule heating (P = I^2 * R).

thermostat_sensor.name: Thermostat & Bimetallic Sensor Probe
thermostat_sensor.description: Temperature regulator containing a bimetallic strip that bends to break electrical contact when water reaches the preset cut-off temperature (e.g. 65 °C).

cold_water_inlet.name: Cold Water Inlet Pipe with Dip Tube
cold_water_inlet.description: Inlet pipe with a long vertical dip tube delivering cold, dense water directly to the bottom of the cylinder near the heating element.

hot_water_outlet.name: Hot Water Outlet Pipe
hot_water_outlet.description: Outlet drawing less dense, buoyant heated water from the very top of the cylinder for distribution throughout the domestic plumbing system.

sacrificial_anode.name: Sacrificial Magnesium Anode Rod
sacrificial_anode.description: Highly reactive magnesium metal rod that preferentially oxidises (corrodes) to electrochemically protect the inner steel tank from rusting.

insulation_casing.name: Polyurethane Foam Thermal Insulation
insulation_casing.description: Dense, non-conductive polyurethane foam layer minimizing conduction and radiation heat loss to the surrounding roof space.

safety_relief_valve.name: Temperature & Pressure (T&P) Safety Valve
safety_relief_valve.description: Mechanical safety valve that automatically discharges water if internal pressure exceeds 400-600 kPa or temperature exceeds 95 °C to prevent tank rupture.
